@yandy-r/ycc-opencode.description: The opencode npm plugin and its only install route: one V2 plugin registers skills, agents, commands, shared helpers, MCP servers, the sensitive-file guard and instructions through its setup hook; install.sh --target opencode writes its plugins entry.

gates: CI publishes with provenance through release.yml on a maintainer-pushed product tag using npm trusted publishing (OIDC, no token): GitHub-hosted runner, Node 24, pinned npm@11.21.1, release environment approval, and a package-specific trusted publisher on npmjs.com for owner yandy-r, repo ystack, workflow release.yml, environment release with npm publish allowed (settings not verified; no publish attempted)
opencode.notes: Primary opencode route since YAN-1973: install.sh --target opencode (base step, or --package @yandy-r/ycc-opencode) writes the plugins entry (local mode: a file:// directory entry for this checkout; repo mode: the published lockstep version) and retires the old file copy. The V2 setup hook registers components and delivers instructions through the context hook; the @yandy-r npm scope is owned.

installer-fallback.description: Internal modeling key for install.sh-only artifacts that no native package carries today; not a public installable package id and never catalog-listed.

claude.notes: install.sh only: Claude rules, CLAUDE.md instructions, settings, and the statusline. No Claude ycc-rules package exists.

codex.notes: install.sh only: Codex agent TOML files, AGENTS.md instructions, and config settings; Codex plugins cannot carry these.

cursor.notes: install.sh only: Cursor CLI settings (cli-config.json, --global). Hooks ship only in the native ycc-hooks package (sessionStart); WorktreeCreate is not implemented for Cursor.

opencode.notes: install.sh only: opencode.json settings (model, providers, agent model pins, subagent depth, the goal plugin) and the global AGENTS.md link (--rules). Skills, agents, commands, shared helpers, MCP servers and the sensitive-file guard ship only in @yandy-r/ycc-opencode.

agents.notes: install.sh only: skills and ycc-shared into ~/.agents. The npx skills path is unspiked.

omp.notes: install.sh --target omp, user scope only: --rules links AGENTS.md into the omp agent dir; --settings merges ycc-owned modelRoles.{default,slow,task}, retry.fallbackChains.{default,slow,task} (bare fallback model, keeps the turn's thinking level; OMP also uses default for chat roles without a chain and single-model subagents) and tools.approvalMode into config.yml (hash-owned; user edits and project config win). Rules ship natively in ycc-rules; the status line is unsupported.

pi.notes: Deferred, user scope only: --rules links AGENTS.md into <agentDir> (never APPEND_SYSTEM.md, which a trusted project file replaces); opt-in --settings merges defaultModel into settings.json and --mcp merges the server set into mcp.json; owned -~/.agents/skills/<n>/SKILL.md overrides hide duplicate ~/.agents copies.
